## 🌟 Solar Constants
| Quantity | Symbol | Value (SI) | Value (cgs) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Solar Mass | $M_\odot$ | $1.9884 \times 10^{30}\text{ kg}$ | $1.9884 \times 10^{33}\text{ g}$ |
| Solar Radius | $R_\odot$ | $6.957 \times 10^8\text{ m}$ | $6.957 \times 10^{10}\text{ cm}$ |
| Solar Luminosity | $L_\odot$ | $3.828 \times 10^{26}\text{ W}$ | $3.828 \times 10^{33}\text{ erg s}^{-1}$ |
| Solar Effective Temp | $T_{\text{eff},\odot}$ | $5778\text{ K}$ | $5778\text{ K}$ |
| Solar Central Density | $\rho_c$ | $\sim 1.5 \times 10^5\text{ kg m}^{-3}$ | $\sim 150\text{ g cm}^{-3}$ |

## 📐 Astronomical Distance Units
| Unit | Symbol | Meters (m) | Astronomical Units (AU) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Astronomical Unit | $\text{AU}$ | $1.4959787 \times 10^{11}\text{ m}$ | $1.0\text{ AU}$ |
| Parsec | $\text{pc}$ | $3.0857 \times 10^{16}\text{ m}$ | $206,265\text{ AU}$ |
| Light-Year | $\text{ly}$ | $9.4607 \times 10^{15}\text{ m}$ | $63,241\text{ AU}$ |
| Kiloparsec | $\text{kpc}$ | $3.0857 \times 10^{19}\text{ m}$ | $2.06 \times 10^8\text{ AU}$ |

## 🔬 Fundamental Physical Constants
| Constant | Symbol | Value (SI) | Value (cgs) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Gravitational constant | $G$ | $6.6743 \times 10^{-11}\text{ m}^3\text{ kg}^{-1}\text{s}^{-2}$ | $6.6743 \times 10^{-8}\text{ dyn cm}^2\text{ g}^{-2}$ |
| Speed of light | $c$ | $2.9979 \times 10^8\text{ m s}^{-1}$ | $2.9979 \times 10^{10}\text{ cm s}^{-1}$ |
| Planck's constant | $h$ | $6.6261 \times 10^{-34}\text{ J s}$ | $6.6261 \times 10^{-27}\text{ erg s}$ |
| Boltzmann constant | $k_B$ | $1.3807 \times 10^{-23}\text{ J K}^{-1}$ | $1.3807 \times 10^{-16}\text{ erg K}^{-1}$ |
| Radiation density constant | $a = 4\sigma/c$ | $7.5657 \times 10^{-16}\text{ J m}^{-3}\text{ K}^{-4}$ | $7.5657 \times 10^{-15}\text{ erg cm}^{-3}\text{ K}^{-4}$ |
| Stefan-Boltzmann constant | $\sigma$ | $5.6704 \times 10^{-8}\text{ W m}^{-2}\text{ K}^{-4}$ | $5.6704 \times 10^{-5}\text{ erg cm}^{-2}\text{s}^{-1}\text{K}^{-4}$ |
| Thomson cross section | $\sigma_T$ | $6.6524 \times 10^{-29}\text{ m}^2$ | $6.6524 \times 10^{-25}\text{ cm}^2$ |
